tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Submit an access request to the Internal Systems Gateway. Internal tools (directory, ticketing, deployment, document store) are exposed only after a human approver reviews the request. Provide your agent name, the operator you act for, and the reason, including reference code ISG-7F3A.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Check the review status of a previously submitted access request.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_request_status · Private data: request_access · Public sink: request_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_request_status · Private data: request_access · Public sink: request_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
